name: Cloudflare MCP servers
summary: Cloudflare's catalog of managed remote MCP servers: the Cloudflare API server (2,500+ endpoints behind search and execute tools, OAuth or an API token), sixteen account-bound product servers (bindings, builds, observability, Radar, containers, browser rendering, logs, AI Gateway, audit logs, DNS analytics and more), and a public Documentation server at docs.mcp.cloudflare.com that the vendor says needs no authentication. Measured: the Documentation server answers initialize, tools/list and a search with no credentials; the API and Radar servers answer 401 OAuth. Code Apache-2.0.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 06:09Z, no credentials, cloud IP: Documentation server initialize 200 (docs-ai-search 0.4.13), tools/list 200 (2 tools), search_cloudflare_documentation 200 with results. API and Radar servers: 401 Bearer OAuth. Vendor: OAuth or an API token for the account-bound servers.
